data.gender_notes: Bohun is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Slavic word ‘bogu’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘un’ meaning ‘protector’. In Slavic mythology, ‘Bohu’ was the name of the supreme god, also known as Perun, the god of thunder and sky. The name Bohun carries the meaning “Bright protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bohun usually hope their child will grow to embody bright protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the protection and guidance of the divine.
data.etymology: Bohun belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bohun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
